patterns.title: Named BU beats generic AI
patterns.winnersDo: Attach to HK Express, Cargo, Inflight, or Flight Ops in the first sentence.
patterns.weHave: HKG transfer desk / Airport Systems is the owner. Say that, not “AI for aviation”.
patterns.pitch: Open with the desk, the queue, and Q77 — not the model.

patterns.title: 90-second theater
patterns.winnersDo: Judges must see the product: trolley, robot, briefing card, typhoon button.
patterns.weHave: Simulate Typhoon Delay and Late Inbound CX254 already refresh the live queue.
patterns.pitch: Narrate the six-step demo as ops, not as a tech tour.

patterns.title: Dual beneficiary
patterns.winnersDo: Passenger care plus a second ledger: revenue, labour, ESG data, or safety.
patterns.weHave: Passenger protection plus desk throughput in a typhoon bank.
patterns.pitch: Name both: misconnect care and minutes off the transfer queue.

patterns.title: Feasibility 2026 is not lifestyle 2025
patterns.winnersDo: BU judges now score adoption path. FlyLab (pilots + IT, summarise existing briefings) is the closer analogue than U-Explore.
patterns.weHave: Deterministic engine, Altéa/FIDS/CANS pilot note, no Altéa write in week 1.
patterns.pitch: We sit beside Passenger Recovery. We do not replace it.

patterns.title: Champions rarely open-source
patterns.winnersDo: Win on pain, BU, and theater. Public GitHub is mostly participant trip planners.
patterns.weHave: A real repo with tests. Do not treat GitHub stars as the scoreboard.
patterns.pitch: Show the iPad and the reasoning strings, not a star count.

patterns.title: Delay re-plan without a desk owner loses
patterns.winnersDo: Fight4Flight (2017 runner-up) notified and re-planned from the passenger side. It did not win.
patterns.weHave: Agent-in-the-loop on an iPad. Approve is the only send.
patterns.pitch: The missing 2017 piece was the transfer desk. That is the product.

patterns.title: Cathay already bought mass IROPS
patterns.winnersDo: Do not pitch into a purchased capability as if the market were empty.
patterns.weHave: Last-90-minute special handling: UM, wheelchair, unsplittable party, MCT + walk.
patterns.pitch: Passenger Recovery does 8,000 pax / 40 min. We do tight connections the mass tool cannot walk-time.

patterns.title: LLM-decides-rebooking is a foil
patterns.winnersDo: BU and IT will not let a model pick the flight.
patterns.weHave: Engine decides. LLM drafts. Flight-number guard. reasoning[] is verbatim.
patterns.pitch: The guard is the product, not ChatGPT.

patterns.title: Control cycle, station clock, sim, kill switch
patterns.winnersDo: SpaceX-class ops: read inputs, compute state, write outputs, wait for the clock. Config for non-software engineers.
patterns.weHave: FIDS + PNR in, slack/MCT state, options + draft out. MCT table is the DSL. Sim seed. RECONNECT_PILOT=off.
patterns.pitch: Say it in ops English, not brand English.

patterns.title: Walk time and special handling are the wedge
patterns.winnersDo: ConnectionSaver treated gate walk as a product (SMS with minutes). MCT tables lie for PRM and UM.
patterns.weHave: Gate walk +15 WCH +20 UM, CX-metal-only for UM, unsplittable party, downgrade protection.
patterns.pitch: Mass reaccom does not escort an unaccompanied minor through HKG T1.
